title: Integer * date is an integer

source.quote: Multiplication (*) INTEGER CURRENCY REAL Date/time INTEGER INTEGER CURRENCY REAL INTEGER
source.supports: the Multiplication (*) table: the INTEGER row gives INTEGER under Date/time

source.quote: This format uses a floating-point number internally
source.supports: a date is stored as a floating-point number: the other reading

derivation: 1900-01-01 as a number is 2. INTEGER * Date/time is INTEGER in the table: 2 * 2 = 4.
alternative: A date is a floating-point number, so the product is a decimal number: 4.0 (double).
notes: The Microsoft table is the only source that speaks of multiplying by a date, and it has no row for a date on the left side.
